name: Tiles Survive!
storyline: In a zombie apocalypse, players awaken in a ruined world and must explore grid-based tiles to gather resources, build a secure base, recruit survivors with unique abilities, and fend off endless hordes while uncovering faction secrets across chapters.
summary: You will follow former Army Special Forces Officer Sarge, who leads a group of survivors on a quest to build a new stronghold whilst facing the relentless threat of a zombie horde.
